palette.scope: These twelve supplied Night images only.
palette.reason: Blue sky, cool blue rock/roof surfaces and dark teal ground read as night. Cyan gate lamps and warm Waycamp windows/fire remain locally distinct. No magenta whole-scene night cast is visible.

route_and_trainer_readability.scope: Static near route, trainer silhouette and pictured local landmarks only.
route_and_trainer_readability.reason: Trainer torso, legs and shoes remain visible; dirt paths separate from surrounding green ground. Gate lamps identify the forward destination; Waycamp houses/tents/fire/props establish camp identity. No gross buried trainer body is apparent in these originals.

contact.scope: Visible Realm Gate forward contact; no physics/collision inference.
contact.reason: The lower gate masonry/wood threshold appears above the grassy approach with a visible gap and no continuous approach connection shown. Reverse and Waycamp frames do not expose the same junction; their visible trainer stands show no gross body burial.

material_appearance.scope: Visible surfaces in this partial packet.
material_appearance.reason: Broad turf, repeated narrow dirt strip, abrupt camp dirt/grass edges and coarse stone/roof textures remain below the coherent full material bar. The small shrub left of Realm Gate's approach has a harsh black/white speckled surface.

static_rain_distinction.reason: Rain streaks distinguish the four rain views. Near palette and route remain similar and readable. This does not certify weather evolution or a numeric visibility range.

complete_night_atmosphere_matrix.reason: Only two destinations and one destination's rain views are supplied; no night Aviary/upper settlement/perch or transition coverage is present.

findings.requirement: Structures/approaches must have readable ground contact without visible floating separation.
findings.observation: The forward gate base/wood threshold has a visible gap above the green route-side ground. The route leads toward a raised lower edge rather than a visible connected entrance surface.
findings.limits: Projected static appearance only; hidden supports, intended magic, collision, traversability or source cause are not inferred.

findings.requirement: Cloudreach night reads dark blue with contained practical lights and legible local forms.
findings.observation: Cool blue surroundings and teal ground keep cyan gate lamps distinct. Waycamp windows, string bulbs and fire form warm local accents against blue stone/roof/sky.
findings.limits: No Aviary windows, unseen destination, moving-light transition, device or whole-night palette certification.

findings.requirement: Normal camera should preserve trainer and route/edge readability.
findings.observation: Trainer body and feet remain visible against dirt/teal ground. Forward gate route and routes between Waycamp houses are distinguishable. Reverse cliff/cloud gap remains readable; dark bushes and far faces have weak detail but do not hide the trainer or near route.
findings.limits: No earned arrival/departure, navigation, exact drop distance, face identity, animation, depth fairness or collision proof.

findings.requirement: Coherent intentional surfaces without fragmented/placeholder appearance.
findings.observation: The left Realm Gate approach shrub is conspicuously speckled black/white. Gate/rock surfaces are coarse; ground is broad uniform turf and a repeated narrow dirt strip. Waycamp paths have visible angular/straight material edges and sparse transitions despite readable houses/props.
findings.limits: No shader, renderer, texture/LOD or lighting-cause diagnosis; no before/current regression asserted.

findings.requirement: World remains readable without heavy UI obstruction under the full appearance/readability bar.
findings.observation: The objective/minimap panels occupy a large right-side world region. Text remains legible, and the near route/trainer remain visible, but the panels obscure part of scenery and structure context.
findings.limits: Static panel size/coverage only; no device/controller or interaction assessment.
